free_tier.stated: Plus is USD 5 per month for 5 sandboxes, 2 GB of storage, a 4-hour session timeout and up to 4 vCPU. Pro runs from USD 15 per month (10 sandboxes, 2 GB) through USD 30 (25 sandboxes, 10 GB, 8-hour timeout, up to 8 vCPU), USD 60 (60 sandboxes) to USD 100 (150 sandboxes). Code executions are not limited by plan: plans differ on sandbox count, storage, session timeout, compute capacity and support. There is no free plan.

retention.stated: The session timeout is the binding term: 4 hours on Plus and 8 hours on Pro, so a sandbox cannot hold a job longer than that no matter how much CPU it has.

chaining: USD 5 a month for five sandboxes with no per-execution charge is the cheapest flat subscription found it suits a fixed small fleet of long-lived Docker environments where the count is known, and it does not suit fan-out because every sandbox beyond five needs a plan change.

notes: It is recorded as paid-only because the vendor states plainly that there is no free plan, which refutes the 'start free' line in the page description that the page itself then contradicts in its own FAQ. The RAM per sandbox is not stated on the pricing page, so shape carries null for RAM; 'up to 4 vCPU' is the only compute number published. Session timeouts of 4 and 8 hours are short for an agent that runs overnight.
